description: Adopt the native TypeScript 7 compiler for monorepo type-checking and eligible builds while retaining the TypeScript 6 compatibility API for tools that embed TypeScript.
deviation_notes: Supersedes the deferred typescript6_major_migration stub. TypeScript 6 remains in scope only as the compatibility bridge required by TypeScript 7.0 tooling. The controlled benchmark has not been accepted: the 2026-07-15 user-authorized CPU-idle override retained resource safeguards, and the reading-advantage TypeScript 6 baseline reached the 128 MiB swap stop-loss.
